story: An icon of the skies, the Tawny Eagle (Aquila rapax) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Arid/semi-arid habitats: deserts; steppes; open savannah; grassland; and dry woodland, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Vulnerable (VU), the Tawny Eagle is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Tawny Eagle helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Tawny Eagle, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
